step2.ptxt: The steering lock ECU is not connected to the CAN communication system. It communicates with the body multiplex communication system via LIN communication with the certification ECU.

atten3.ptxt: If the certification ECU is replaced, the engine may not start unless the driver side door is opened and closed. (This makes the certification ECU store the current steering lock position)
